method.input: Authorized mobile-playtest helper; native CDP touch only; maximum two contacts
method.observation: Every adaptive action followed inspection of the preceding screenshot. Visible handbook, HUD and map informed decisions. No source, tests, docs, earlier reviews, game handles, hidden state, query overrides or simulation/resource manipulation used.
method.capture: Synthetic phone emulation; live scene captured then automatically paused between acts. Screenshot scale 3.
method.rendering: Helper reported Software-WebGL fallback; renderer not certified.

scale.overall_method: Judgment of observed mobile experience, not a completion percentage or arithmetic average. Provisional from one loss; no physical hardware claims.

overall_mobile.reason: A complete touch-driven attempt reached a legitimate loss with all three recoveries. Strong atmosphere and explicit objectives coexist with difficult portrait navigation, dense controls, and obstructed combat views.

controls.reason: Movement, turning, held fire, fire-drag aiming, reload, map and recovery responded sufficiently to progress. Simultaneous fire and recovery succeeded. Fine positioning and aiming demanded several corrections; one dash displaced the view substantially. This does not establish an input defect.

gameplay.reason: Recovery objectives, enemies, replenishment and timed coil exposure created visible progression and decisions. Threat pressure remained active during recovery and the custodian fight. Low accuracy, repeated obstruction and a fatal burst limited successful combat; later phases unassessed.

presentation.reason: Cohesive teal/amber visual language, rain, industrial structures, a striking circular relay, designed title screen and clear terminal card. Close views often became flat wall surfaces or black cover shapes, reducing scene legibility.

usability.reason: Concise handbook, paused map with named destinations, proximity numbers and changing HOLD TO RECOVER control supported independent progress. Finding a usable firing face and exact ring approach still required detours and repeated checks.

readability.reason: Primary health/ammo and final results read clearly. Secondary HUD, map labels, threat indicators and custodian percentages are small at 390 CSS pixels; dense overlays compete with the scene.

terminal.note: Terminal card labels time cumulative play time; this was the only fresh attempt and no retry was activated. No later coil values inferred.

observed_sequence: Read visible operator handbook, then entered storm once.
Held opening fire: ammunition 30 to 09 and opening guard disappeared. Final card, rather than inferred individual kills, supplies elimination count.
Reloaded and moved toward west archive. Overshot into wall/storage views, lost shield, consulted map and backtracked.
At 00:24 health 65 and control said 2.2m closer. Corrections reached near-ring prompt, but an early recovery hold failed out of reach; no recovery was credited.
At 00:29 reached active recovery control with health 41. Held recovery while firing/dragging; Mara recovered at 00:33 and health read 58.
Turned through visible scene swipes, moved toward Heart and fired at visible relay guard. Several short corrections, including a side step, reached Sera ring; recovery confirmed at 00:47.
Traversed toward east archive under fire; fired, reloaded and corrected position. Elian recovery confirmed at 00:59; all three numbered memory boxes illuminated.
Approached custodian, dashed and fired into obstructing cover; all coils initially remained 100%. Strafed to a clearer view, dragged fire aim; coil 2 fell to 47% at 01:10, health 41.
Reloaded and dashed sideways to evade lane, consulted map, reoriented and attempted another coil burst. Actual SIGNAL LOST screen appeared with 01:14 mission time. No retry.

issues.observed: West approach and around-storage captures show walls filling nearly the entire scene; player overshot and backtracked while losing shield/health.
issues.impact: Hard to combine route finding with active threat awareness in portrait.
issues.inference: A more prominent ground route/obstacle cue could reduce disorientation; this run cannot isolate geometry design from reviewer movement errors.

issues.observed: An early hold produced no recovery. Later Heart approach read 0.7m then 0.4m outside reach before a side step activated HOLD TO RECOVER.
issues.impact: Recovery requires careful positioning while exposed; numerical feedback helped but multiple adjustments were needed.
issues.inference: A clearer visible reachable region may help; no failed valid hold or broken interaction was established.

issues.observed: First custodian burst struck cover; columns and black low cover obscured coil faces. Repositioned burst reduced only coil 2 to 47%.
issues.impact: Selecting a clear firing angle was difficult; substantial ammunition went into misses or obstruction.
issues.inference: Portrait field of view and aim skill may both contribute. No hit-registration defect established.

issues.observed: Map labels, percentages and secondary status copy are markedly smaller than primary ammo/health; status and directional markers share the busy scene.
issues.impact: Readable when paused and inspected, but likely demands attention during combat.
issues.inference: Actual human real-time readability needs physical-device testing.

covered: Map planning and automatic objective changes
Damage, shield loss/regeneration and recovery replenishment
Custodian armor/exposure and partial coil damage
coverage.uncertainty: One paused synthetic attempt supports a limited assessment. Failure and 14% accuracy reflect reviewer execution as well as interface demands. No completion inferred from three recovered memories.

artifacts.retention: All screenshots, misses, failed hold, detours and final loss retained.

write_scope: Only new own media/action log and this review JSON written. No runtime edits, builds, commits, publication or existing document changes.
